description: Free: the Lightning address and LNURL that extend this zone or hostname pro rata when anyone pays it (no token needed to pay). Made once, then the same address is returned. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

api_key.description: Instead of token: an account API key (jdk_...) whose scope covers this object (read, or write for changes).

token.description: Its token (jdz_... or jdh_...); or give api_key.

name: renewal_address
title: Lightning address that renews a zone or hostname (free, token)
